messages:
Maya: quick thread - how should per-tenant SLO overrides look in Console + API? thinking about visibility, audit, and alert routing impact.

Jon: three outputs we need: UI surface, API shape, and telemetry/audit. otherwise ops will be surprised.

Samir: UI idea: an explicit 'Overrides' card on the SLO detail page, collapsed by default, with a visible badge 'tenant override'.

Emily: UX rules: collapsed by default, require 'reason' field, show who and when, and a 'view effective SLO' diff link. make override state visually distinct from base.

Leah: API proposal:
```
PATCH /api/v1/slo-rules/:rule_id/overrides
body: {
  "tenant_id": "acct-123",
  "override": { "threshold_pct": 98 },
  "reason": "enterprise contract",
  "effective_until": "2026-06-30T00:00:00Z"
}
```
response returns override_id and audit_id.

Kevin: read endpoints should return computed effective SLO to avoid multiple calls. e.g. GET /slo-rules/:id?tenant=acct-123 -> { base, override, effective } (we send as single payload). cache effective for 5m.

Maya: telemetry: emit events slo.override.created/updated/deleted with actor_id, tenant_id, rule_id, delta, and source (console|api|terraform).

Jon: also emit routing.recalc.request when override changes so Alerting service can recompute contact lists and policies. otherwise dangling routes.

Samir: permissions: disallow tightening overrides unless caller is in admin/ops plan. if someone tries to tighten require explicit 'force_override' and an audit reason.

Emily: rollout UX: when saving an override show a preview modal: "X incidents would have fired in the last 30d under this override" with sample alert rows and option to continue or cancel. helps guardrails.

Leah: storage note: store overrides as first-class resources with ids and retention. keep full audit trail and ensure rollbacks of SLO rules don't drop overrides.

Kevin: implement as delta-only storage; compute effective SLO at read time. avoid duplicating SLO evaluation logic. add 5m cache and invalidation on override change.

Maya: action items: Leah to spec API + audit output, Emily to mock Console views + preview modal, Samir to draft permission matrix, Jon to add telemetry events/schema, Kevin to prototype caching. I'll own rollout and runbook.

DeployBot: deploy queued to staging at 2026-03-20T14:02:00Z :package:
